text_md: Bangor Pa. may 22 nd /914. Col Rosevelt / Comrade & Friend Gen Dear Sir I am one of D.E. Sickles old Regt & Briglade I Served Through all of the civil War. During the 5. years With Gen Sickles When He Loost His dogg. Then He Leftus. Regret your Offsence From This country 1 Durffing your trip to S.A. J. Say me Pfinghott Here & Had a Soille telk with Him about you & The Political Situation of the Icountry I am with you for the Election of Tifford Pfnchott as U.S. Senitor. Vone Boaw Here must Be Repealed. as we are Deprived of Johns for Whorver We Desire at the Primaries. if you come to Easton or Bangor Pa II would wike to pa See your Address 25 market St Bangor Yours very Resp. Caleb Aber
